weekly_monthly_infeasibility_note: weekly and monthly aggregation windows were NOT computed. The frozen injector's eligible evaluation pool (config/anomalies.yaml, eligible_days: [26, 34]) spans exactly 9 contiguous days per replicate. A 'weekly' window is barely constructible (9/7 ~= 1.3 windows); 'monthly' is not constructible at all within a single replicate. Relaxing the frozen injector's 9-day structure to force these windows into existence would mean building new injection machinery, out of scope for an evaluation task (TASK7_FULL_ROADMAP_FOR_CLAUDE_CODE.md SS0.2). This is reported as an honest infeasibility finding, not a silent omission.
excluded_baseline_false_positives_note: Days excluded from the sweep pool because they were ALREADY flagged (r_day > threshold) at zero injection -- injecting a magnitude into an already-flagged day tests nothing about that magnitude. See mdo_curve.py's run_mdo_sweep() docstring.
